# Card Effect Complexity Tier Analysis

**Generated by**: `scripts/complexity_tiers.py`
**Uncovered cards analyzed**: 3135

## Methodology

Cards are classified by analyzing their `functional_text_plain` against pattern sets:

- **Simple** (~15 min each): Stat modifications (+N power/defense), draw/discard N cards,
  gain/lose life, deal damage, gain resources, go again as text, opt N, intimidate.
  These map directly to existing template functions in keywords.py (effect_draw,
  effect_deal_damage, effect_gain_life, etc.).

- **Medium** (~30 min each): Token creation, counter manipulation, banish-from-zone,
  graveyard recursion, simple conditionals (if X has Y), specific triggers
  (when this attacks/hits/enters), phase triggers, next-attack buffs, reveal effects,
  zone-counting conditions. These require combining 2-3 existing primitives with
  light conditional logic.

- **Complex** (~60+ min each): Player choices (choose one/up to), replacement effects
  (instead), general triggered abilities (whenever), scaling effects (for each),
  deck searching/tutoring, transform/transcend, cross-zone play, cheat-into-play,
  control-changing, copy effects, damage prevention, restriction effects (can't be),
  cost modification, timing changes. These require new infrastructure or multi-step
  agent interaction.

Cards with 4+ lines of functional text are auto-classified as Complex;
3 lines as Medium (multi-paragraph text correlates with implementation complexity).
